highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and packages compiler-generated XML documentation with managed assemblies.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp binding generation now follows the bundled native source; code using corrected or removed enum members may need migration.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled CCC133 member is corrected to CCC132, retaining numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is unavailable
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and includes upstream m154 bug and buffer-upload fixes.

bullets.lead: XML documentation ships with NuGet packages
bullets.detail: Managed package assemblies now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API prose maintained alongside the C# surface.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz bindings follow the bundled native source
bullets.detail: Generated bindings now track the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia while omitting unsupported callback-heavy families.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the Windows native HarfBuzz build by scoping compiler warning suppression

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp generation now follows the bundled native source, keeping supported bindings synchronized while correcting the CCC132 enum name and removing aggregate flag masks.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also begins the 4.154 line with updated documentation and binding-generation infrastructure.
